THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 02.02.2026, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 W.P.(C). No.969 OF 2026  2026:KER:8501  2  BECHU KURIAN THOMAS, J  -------------------------------------------
 W.P.(C). No.969 of 2026  ----------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 2nd day of February, 2026  JUDGMENT
The writ petition was filed seeking a direction to conduct inspection of petitioner's hotel prior to 'Star Classification'.
2. The 1st respondent has filed a statement stating that petitioner's application is being processed and now an inspection is scheduled to be held on 10.02.2026.
3. Since the inspection is already scheduled to be held on 10.02.2026, the petitioner's grievance claimed in this writ petition stands redressed.
In view of the above, this writ petition stands closed, observing that the respondents shall, after the inspection, take a decision without undue delay.

Sd/-
BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE SMF W.P.(C).
